verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API with a Node SDK. Its Sandbox exposes a Sandbox-only endpoint, /sandbox/public_token/create, that creates test Items via the API, so test flows can run programmatically without the interactive Link UI. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI usage, and in Production account linking still goes through the client-side Link component that end users interact with. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation or guides, a headless path for Production account linking, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you can also create Items in Sandbox via the API, using a special Sandbox-only endpoint, /sandbox/public_token/create. This endpoint allows you to generate a public_token for an arbitrary institution ID, initial products, and test credentials.
All Plaid functionality of both the Plaid API and Plaid Link is supported in the Sandbox environment.
you can create an unlimited number of test Items.
